verdict.rationale: Clerky's Partner API uses versioned endpoint paths such as `/v1/document_sets`, so the API is versioned. The pack never documents a deprecation policy, and authentication is still marked 'coming soon', so the API does not appear to be generally available yet. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning policy or changelog, generally available production API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Create a document set from a template. | [`POST /v1/document_sets`]
